barbell_back_squat.title: Barbell Back Squat
barbell_back_squat.setup: Set the bar across the upper back, hands just outside shoulder width. Stand tall with feet about shoulder width and toes slightly out.
barbell_back_squat.movement: Brace, sit the hips down between the feet, and let the knees track over the toes. Reach a controlled depth, then drive the floor away to stand.
barbell_back_squat.safety: Keep the whole foot planted and the bar balanced over mid-foot. Stop if the lower back rounds or the knees collapse inward.
barbell_back_squat.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
barbell_back_squat.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

barbell_bench_press.title: Barbell Bench Press
barbell_bench_press.setup: Lie with eyes under the bar, shoulder blades pulled down and back, feet planted. Grip slightly wider than shoulder width.
barbell_bench_press.movement: Unrack over the shoulders, lower to the lower chest with forearms nearly vertical, then press up and slightly back.
barbell_bench_press.safety: Use safeties or a spotter for challenging sets. Keep shoulders pinned and wrists stacked over elbows.
barbell_bench_press.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
barbell_bench_press.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

conventional_deadlift.title: Conventional Deadlift
conventional_deadlift.setup: Stand with the bar over mid-foot. Hinge down, grip outside the legs, bring shins close, and brace with a long neutral spine.
conventional_deadlift.movement: Push through the floor while keeping the bar close. Extend knees and hips together, stand tall, then hinge to return the bar.
conventional_deadlift.safety: Do not jerk the bar or lean back at lockout. End the set if spinal position or bar control changes.
conventional_deadlift.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
conventional_deadlift.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

overhead_press.title: Overhead Press
overhead_press.setup: Hold the bar at upper-chest height with wrists stacked over elbows. Set feet firmly and brace glutes and trunk.
overhead_press.movement: Move the head slightly back, press the bar vertically, then finish with arms overhead and ribs controlled. Lower to the shoulders.
overhead_press.safety: Avoid leaning back to turn the press into an incline press. Use a load that allows a clear vertical path.
overhead_press.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
overhead_press.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

bent_over_row.title: Bent-Over Row
bent_over_row.setup: Grip the bar, soften the knees, and hinge until the torso is stable and nearly parallel to the floor.
bent_over_row.movement: Pull the bar toward the lower ribs, bringing elbows behind the body. Pause briefly and lower until the arms are long.
bent_over_row.safety: Hold the same torso angle throughout. Reduce load if momentum or lower-back extension drives the repetition.
bent_over_row.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
bent_over_row.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

pull_up.title: Pull-Up
pull_up.setup: Take an overhand grip just outside shoulder width. Hang long with ribs controlled and shoulders active.
pull_up.movement: Drive elbows down and pull the upper chest toward the bar. Lower under control to a full active hang.
pull_up.safety: Avoid swinging, neck reaching, or dropping into the bottom. Use assistance if full-range repetitions are not controlled.
pull_up.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
pull_up.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

lat_pulldown.title: Lat Pulldown
lat_pulldown.setup: Secure the thighs under the pad and grip the bar wider than the shoulders. Sit tall with a slight torso lean.
lat_pulldown.movement: Pull elbows down until the bar approaches the upper chest, then let the arms lengthen without shrugging.
lat_pulldown.safety: Do not pull behind the neck or rock the torso. Keep the cable path controlled.
lat_pulldown.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
lat_pulldown.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

leg_press.title: Leg Press
leg_press.setup: Place feet shoulder width on the platform and keep hips and back against the pad. Release the safeties with knees soft.
leg_press.movement: Lower the platform until the knees reach a comfortable bend, then press through the whole foot without locking hard.
leg_press.safety: Use a range where the pelvis stays on the pad. Keep knees tracking with toes and re-engage safeties before exiting.
leg_press.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
leg_press.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

romanian_deadlift.title: Romanian Deadlift
romanian_deadlift.setup: Hold the bar at the thighs, stand tall, and soften the knees. Brace before initiating the hinge.
romanian_deadlift.movement: Push hips back while sliding the bar close to the legs. Stop at strong hamstring tension, then drive hips forward.
romanian_deadlift.safety: This is a hip hinge, not a deep squat. Keep the spine long and never chase depth by rounding.
romanian_deadlift.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
romanian_deadlift.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

dumbbell_lunge.title: Dumbbell Lunge
dumbbell_lunge.setup: Stand tall with a dumbbell at each side and enough space to step. Set the trunk before moving.
dumbbell_lunge.movement: Step forward, lower both knees with the front foot flat, then push through the front foot to return.
dumbbell_lunge.safety: Keep the front knee tracking over the foot and land under control. Shorten range if balance changes.
dumbbell_lunge.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
dumbbell_lunge.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

biceps_curl.title: Biceps Curl
biceps_curl.setup: Stand tall holding the weight with palms forward. Keep elbows close to the ribs and shoulders relaxed.
biceps_curl.movement: Curl without moving the upper arms, squeeze near the top, then lower until the elbows are straight.
biceps_curl.safety: Avoid swinging the torso or letting shoulders roll forward. Reduce load if the elbows drift.
biceps_curl.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
biceps_curl.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

triceps_pushdown.title: Triceps Pushdown
triceps_pushdown.setup: Face the cable with elbows tucked to the sides and forearms near parallel to the floor. Stand with a stable base.
triceps_pushdown.movement: Extend the elbows until the arms are straight, pause, then return without letting the upper arms move forward.
triceps_pushdown.safety: Keep wrists neutral and shoulders down. Do not use body weight to force the cable.
triceps_pushdown.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
triceps_pushdown.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

plank.title: Plank
plank.setup: Place elbows under shoulders and extend the legs. Form a straight line from head through heels.
plank.movement: Brace the abdomen and glutes, press the floor away, and hold without changing spinal or pelvic position.
plank.breathing: Breathe continuously and evenly. Do not hold your breath during a sustained position.
plank.tempo: Hold only while alignment and calm breathing remain steady.
plank.safety: Stop before the hips sag or the lower back arches. Shorten the lever by using the knees when needed.

barbell_front_squat.title: Barbell Front Squat
barbell_front_squat.setup: Rest the bar across the front shoulders with elbows high. Stand shoulder width and brace the upper back.
barbell_front_squat.movement: Descend between the feet while keeping elbows lifted, then drive up with chest and hips rising together.
barbell_front_squat.safety: Keep the bar supported by the shoulders rather than the hands. Stop if elbows drop or the back rounds.
barbell_front_squat.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
barbell_front_squat.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

goblet_squat.title: Goblet Squat
goblet_squat.setup: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell close to the chest. Set feet around shoulder width with toes slightly out.
goblet_squat.movement: Sit down between the feet, keep the weight close, then press through the whole foot to stand.
goblet_squat.safety: Keep knees aligned with toes and ribs stacked over the pelvis. Do not let the weight pull the torso forward.
goblet_squat.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
goblet_squat.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

hack_squat.title: Hack Squat
hack_squat.setup: Set shoulders and back against the machine pad with feet evenly placed on the platform.
hack_squat.movement: Release the stops, lower with hips and back supported, then press the platform away through the whole foot.
hack_squat.safety: Do not let the pelvis curl off the pad or lock the knees forcefully. Re-engage both stops before leaving.
hack_squat.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
hack_squat.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

leg_extension.title: Leg Extension
leg_extension.setup: Align knees with the machine pivot and place the pad above the ankles. Sit fully against the backrest.
leg_extension.movement: Extend the knees until the legs are nearly straight, pause, then lower without letting the stack drop.
leg_extension.safety: Use a pain-free range and controlled load. Avoid kicking or lifting the hips from the seat.
leg_extension.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
leg_extension.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

lying_leg_curl.title: Lying Leg Curl
lying_leg_curl.setup: Align knees near the machine pivot and place the roller just above the heels. Keep hips against the pad.
lying_leg_curl.movement: Curl heels toward the glutes, pause, then lower the weight to a long-leg position.
lying_leg_curl.safety: Do not arch the lower back or lift the hips. Use a range that remains comfortable behind the knee.
lying_leg_curl.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
lying_leg_curl.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

barbell_hip_thrust.title: Barbell Hip Thrust
barbell_hip_thrust.setup: Place the upper back on a stable bench and the padded bar across the hip crease. Plant feet around hip width.
barbell_hip_thrust.movement: Drive through the heels and extend the hips until the torso is level, then lower under control.
barbell_hip_thrust.safety: Keep the chin tucked and ribs down. Finish with glutes, not lower-back overextension.
barbell_hip_thrust.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
barbell_hip_thrust.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

glute_bridge.title: Glute Bridge
glute_bridge.setup: Lie on the floor with knees bent and feet flat near the hips. Set ribs down and pelvis neutral.
glute_bridge.movement: Press through the feet, squeeze the glutes to lift the hips, pause, then lower with control.
glute_bridge.safety: Avoid pushing through the neck or arching the lower back. Adjust foot distance if hamstrings cramp.
glute_bridge.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
glute_bridge.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

bulgarian_split_squat.title: Bulgarian Split Squat
bulgarian_split_squat.setup: Stand one stride in front of a bench and place the rear foot on it. Square the hips and plant the front foot.
bulgarian_split_squat.movement: Lower mostly through the front leg, then drive through the front foot to rise without bouncing.
bulgarian_split_squat.safety: Choose a stance that keeps balance and front-foot pressure. Hold support before adding load if needed.
bulgarian_split_squat.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
bulgarian_split_squat.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

walking_lunge.title: Walking Lunge
walking_lunge.setup: Stand tall with a clear path ahead. Brace and keep weights stable at the sides if loaded.
walking_lunge.movement: Step into a lunge, lower under control, then drive through the front leg and continue into the next step.
walking_lunge.safety: Keep each knee aligned with its foot. Slow down rather than reaching for an excessively long step.
walking_lunge.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
walking_lunge.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

standing_calf_raise.title: Standing Calf Raise
standing_calf_raise.setup: Stand on the balls of the feet with heels free and hold stable support. Keep knees softly extended.
standing_calf_raise.movement: Lower heels to a comfortable stretch, rise as high as possible, pause, then descend slowly.
standing_calf_raise.safety: Keep ankles tracking straight instead of rolling outward. Use support to prevent balance from limiting the set.
standing_calf_raise.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
standing_calf_raise.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

seated_calf_raise.title: Seated Calf Raise
seated_calf_raise.setup: Sit with knees bent, balls of the feet on the platform, and the thigh pad secured above the knees.
seated_calf_raise.movement: Lower the heels, press through the forefoot to raise them fully, pause, then return slowly.
seated_calf_raise.safety: Keep the pad secure and use a controlled stretch. Do not bounce at the bottom.
seated_calf_raise.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
seated_calf_raise.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

incline_barbell_bench_press.title: Incline Barbell Bench Press
incline_barbell_bench_press.setup: Set the bench to a moderate incline, pin shoulder blades to the pad, plant feet, and grip outside shoulder width.
incline_barbell_bench_press.movement: Lower the bar toward the upper chest with forearms vertical, then press upward over the shoulders.
incline_barbell_bench_press.safety: Keep the shoulders down and avoid an excessively steep bench. Use safeties or a spotter.
incline_barbell_bench_press.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
incline_barbell_bench_press.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

dumbbell_bench_press.title: Dumbbell Bench Press
dumbbell_bench_press.setup: Lie with feet planted and shoulder blades set. Start dumbbells over the chest with wrists stacked.
dumbbell_bench_press.movement: Lower the dumbbells beside the chest, then press them up while maintaining stable shoulders.
dumbbell_bench_press.safety: Do not force depth below a comfortable shoulder range. Bring weights down safely rather than dropping them.
dumbbell_bench_press.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
dumbbell_bench_press.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

push_up.title: Push-Up
push_up.setup: Place hands just outside shoulder width and create a straight line from head to heels.
push_up.movement: Lower the chest between the hands with elbows angled back, then press the floor away as one unit.
push_up.safety: Keep hips from sagging and shoulders away from ears. Elevate the hands if full range is not controlled.
push_up.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
push_up.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

chest_fly.title: Dumbbell Chest Fly
chest_fly.setup: Lie on a bench with dumbbells above the chest, palms facing, and elbows softly bent.
chest_fly.movement: Open the arms in a wide arc to a comfortable stretch, then bring them together over the chest.
chest_fly.safety: Maintain the elbow bend and avoid dropping below a safe shoulder range. Use lighter loads than a press.
chest_fly.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
chest_fly.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

cable_crossover.title: Cable Crossover
cable_crossover.setup: Stand between high pulleys in a staggered stance, holding handles with elbows softly bent.
cable_crossover.movement: Sweep hands forward and slightly down until they meet, squeeze, then open under cable control.
cable_crossover.safety: Keep the torso still and shoulders down. Do not let the stacks pull the arms abruptly backward.
cable_crossover.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
cable_crossover.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

machine_chest_press.title: Machine Chest Press
machine_chest_press.setup: Adjust the seat so handles align with mid-chest. Set back and shoulders firmly against the pad.
machine_chest_press.movement: Press handles forward without locking hard, then return until the chest is comfortably stretched.
machine_chest_press.safety: Keep wrists stacked and shoulders down. Adjust range rather than letting elbows travel far behind the body.
machine_chest_press.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
machine_chest_press.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

one_arm_dumbbell_row.title: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
one_arm_dumbbell_row.setup: Support one hand and knee on a bench, plant the other foot, and let the dumbbell hang below the shoulder.
one_arm_dumbbell_row.movement: Pull the elbow toward the hip while keeping the torso square, then lower to a long arm.
one_arm_dumbbell_row.safety: Avoid twisting the trunk or shrugging. Keep the supporting shoulder stable and spine long.
one_arm_dumbbell_row.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
one_arm_dumbbell_row.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

seated_cable_row.title: Seated Cable Row
seated_cable_row.setup: Sit tall with feet braced, knees soft, and arms long. Set shoulders down before pulling.
seated_cable_row.movement: Drive elbows back and bring the handle toward the lower ribs, then extend the arms without collapsing forward.
seated_cable_row.safety: Avoid rocking the torso or rounding to chase range. Keep cable tension controlled.
seated_cable_row.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
seated_cable_row.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

chest_supported_row.title: Chest-Supported Row
chest_supported_row.setup: Set the bench so the chest is supported and feet are stable. Let weights hang with shoulders away from ears.
chest_supported_row.movement: Pull elbows back toward the ribs, pause, then lower to full arm length.
chest_supported_row.safety: Keep the chest on the pad and neck neutral. Reduce load if the shoulders shrug.
chest_supported_row.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
chest_supported_row.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

chin_up.title: Chin-Up
chin_up.setup: Take an underhand shoulder-width grip and begin from an active hang with ribs controlled.
chin_up.movement: Pull elbows down until the chin clears the bar, then lower slowly to full arm length.
chin_up.safety: Avoid swinging or forcing the neck over the bar. Use assistance to preserve full controlled range.
chin_up.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
chin_up.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

face_pull.title: Face Pull
face_pull.setup: Set a rope around face height, stand stable, and begin with arms extended and shoulders down.
face_pull.movement: Pull the rope toward the face while separating the hands and rotating elbows outward, then return slowly.
face_pull.safety: Use a light load and avoid leaning backward. Keep the neck relaxed and wrists aligned.
face_pull.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
face_pull.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

dumbbell_shoulder_press.title: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
dumbbell_shoulder_press.setup: Hold dumbbells beside the shoulders with wrists over elbows. Stand or sit tall and brace.
dumbbell_shoulder_press.movement: Press overhead until arms are long, then lower to the starting position without dropping.
dumbbell_shoulder_press.safety: Keep ribs controlled and avoid leaning back. Use a neutral grip if that is more comfortable for the shoulders.
dumbbell_shoulder_press.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
dumbbell_shoulder_press.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

lateral_raise.title: Lateral Raise
lateral_raise.setup: Stand tall with light dumbbells at the sides, elbows softly bent, and shoulders relaxed.
lateral_raise.movement: Raise arms out to around shoulder height, lead with the elbows, then lower slowly.
lateral_raise.safety: Avoid shrugging, swinging, or lifting through pain. Use less weight to preserve control.
lateral_raise.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
lateral_raise.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

rear_delt_fly.title: Rear Delt Fly
rear_delt_fly.setup: Hinge with a long spine and let light dumbbells hang below the shoulders.
rear_delt_fly.movement: Open the arms wide with soft elbows, squeeze behind the shoulders, then return slowly.
rear_delt_fly.safety: Keep the torso still and shoulders away from ears. Avoid turning it into a heavy row.
rear_delt_fly.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
rear_delt_fly.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

hammer_curl.title: Hammer Curl
hammer_curl.setup: Stand tall with dumbbells at the sides and palms facing inward. Pin elbows near the ribs.
hammer_curl.movement: Curl while keeping the neutral grip, pause near the top, then lower to straight arms.
hammer_curl.safety: Avoid torso swing and wrist bending. Stop the set when the elbows begin moving forward.
hammer_curl.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
hammer_curl.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

preacher_curl.title: Preacher Curl
preacher_curl.setup: Adjust the pad so upper arms rest fully on it. Grip the weight with wrists neutral and elbows slightly soft.
preacher_curl.movement: Curl toward the shoulders without lifting the upper arms, then lower slowly before the elbows lock hard.
preacher_curl.safety: Use a conservative load at the stretched bottom position. Never bounce out of extension.
preacher_curl.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
preacher_curl.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

skull_crusher.title: Lying Triceps Extension
skull_crusher.setup: Lie on a bench with the bar over the shoulders, arms vertical, and a secure shoulder-width grip.
skull_crusher.movement: Bend only the elbows to lower toward or just behind the forehead, then extend back to vertical.
skull_crusher.safety: Keep upper arms stable and use a controllable load. Use a spotter or safe bar path near the face.
skull_crusher.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
skull_crusher.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

overhead_triceps_extension.title: Overhead Triceps Extension
overhead_triceps_extension.setup: Hold the weight overhead with elbows pointing forward and trunk braced.
overhead_triceps_extension.movement: Bend the elbows to lower behind the head, then extend until the arms are long overhead.
overhead_triceps_extension.safety: Keep ribs down and avoid flaring the elbows excessively. Choose a grip that feels natural.
overhead_triceps_extension.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
overhead_triceps_extension.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

parallel_bar_dip.title: Parallel-Bar Dip
parallel_bar_dip.setup: Support the body on parallel bars with shoulders down and legs clear of the floor.
parallel_bar_dip.movement: Lower by bending the elbows to a comfortable shoulder depth, then press the bars away to rise.
parallel_bar_dip.safety: Avoid dropping into the bottom or forcing deep range. Use assistance if shoulder position cannot stay controlled.
parallel_bar_dip.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
parallel_bar_dip.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

hanging_leg_raise.title: Hanging Leg Raise
hanging_leg_raise.setup: Hang from a secure bar with shoulders active and legs together. Set the pelvis before moving.
hanging_leg_raise.movement: Curl the pelvis and raise the legs without swinging, then lower slowly to stillness.
hanging_leg_raise.safety: Do not use momentum or hang on painful shoulders. Bend the knees to reduce difficulty.
hanging_leg_raise.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
hanging_leg_raise.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

cable_crunch.title: Cable Crunch
cable_crunch.setup: Kneel facing the cable with the rope beside the head. Keep hips mostly fixed and brace.
cable_crunch.movement: Flex the trunk to bring ribs toward the pelvis, pause, then return without letting the stack pull you up.
cable_crunch.safety: Move through the abdomen rather than yanking with the arms. Keep the neck neutral.
cable_crunch.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
cable_crunch.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

side_plank.title: Side Plank
side_plank.setup: Place the elbow under the shoulder and stack or stagger the feet. Lift into a straight side line.
side_plank.movement: Hold the hips high, brace the side of the trunk, and keep shoulders and pelvis stacked.
side_plank.breathing: Breathe continuously and evenly. Do not hold your breath during a sustained position.
side_plank.tempo: Hold only while the body remains in one straight line.
side_plank.safety: Do not sink into the supporting shoulder. Use a bent lower knee for a shorter lever.

ab_wheel_rollout.title: Ab Wheel Rollout
ab_wheel_rollout.setup: Kneel with the wheel under the shoulders, glutes lightly engaged, and spine neutral.
ab_wheel_rollout.movement: Roll forward while keeping ribs and pelvis connected, pause before the back arches, then pull back with the trunk.
ab_wheel_rollout.safety: Use a short range first. Stop immediately if the lower back sags or the return requires a hip jerk.
ab_wheel_rollout.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
ab_wheel_rollout.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

farmers_carry.title: Farmer's Carry
farmers_carry.setup: Stand between equal loads, hinge to pick them up safely, then stand tall with shoulders set.
farmers_carry.movement: Walk with short controlled steps, weights quiet at the sides, and trunk tall. Turn carefully and set down with a hinge.
farmers_carry.breathing: Take controlled breaths behind a firm brace; avoid breath-holding for the whole carry.
farmers_carry.tempo: Use an even walking pace that keeps posture and grip stable.
farmers_carry.safety: Keep the path clear and do not rush turns. End before grip loss changes posture.

kettlebell_swing.title: Kettlebell Swing
kettlebell_swing.setup: Place the bell ahead of the feet, hinge to grip it, and hike it back with a braced neutral spine.
kettlebell_swing.movement: Snap the hips forward so the bell floats, then let it return and hinge again. Arms guide rather than lift.
kettlebell_swing.breathing: Inhale on the backswing and exhale sharply as the hips extend.
kettlebell_swing.tempo: Use a crisp hip drive and let the bell's pendulum set the rhythm.
kettlebell_swing.safety: This is a hinge, not a squat or shoulder raise. Stop if the bell pulls the spine out of position.

back_extension.title: Back Extension
back_extension.setup: Set the pad below the hip crease and anchor the feet. Start in a long neutral line.
back_extension.movement: Hinge forward at the hips, then squeeze glutes and hamstrings to return to a straight body line.
back_extension.safety: Do not hyperextend above neutral or bounce at the bottom. Keep the neck aligned with the spine.
back_extension.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
back_extension.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

band_pull_apart.title: Band Pull-Apart
band_pull_apart.setup: Hold a light band at shoulder height with arms straight and hands wider than the shoulders.
band_pull_apart.movement: Pull the band apart until it approaches the chest, squeeze the upper back, then return slowly.
band_pull_apart.safety: Keep shoulders down and ribs controlled. Use a lighter band if elbows bend or the torso leans.
band_pull_apart.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
band_pull_apart.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

resistance_band_row.title: Resistance-Band Row
resistance_band_row.setup: Anchor the band securely, sit or stand tall, and begin with arms extended and shoulders set.
resistance_band_row.movement: Pull elbows behind the body, pause with hands near the ribs, then return under band tension.
resistance_band_row.safety: Inspect the band and anchor before use. Keep the face out of the band's recoil path.
resistance_band_row.breathing: Inhale and brace before the lowering phase. Exhale through the hardest part without losing trunk tension.
resistance_band_row.tempo: Lower for about 2 seconds, pause under control, then lift smoothly for 1 second.

treadmill_run.title: Treadmill Run
treadmill_run.setup: Start the belt slowly, stand centered, and build speed only after finding a relaxed stride.
treadmill_run.movement: Run tall with quick quiet foot contacts under the body and relaxed arms swinging front to back.
treadmill_run.breathing: Use rhythmic breathing that matches the effort; slow down if breathing becomes uncontrolled.
treadmill_run.tempo: Keep a sustainable cadence and change speed gradually.
treadmill_run.safety: Use the safety clip, stay away from the rear edge, and reduce speed before stepping off.

indoor_cycling.title: Indoor Cycling
indoor_cycling.setup: Set saddle height so the knee stays slightly bent at the bottom. Adjust reach so shoulders remain relaxed.
indoor_cycling.movement: Pedal smoothly through the full circle with knees tracking forward and hips steady.
indoor_cycling.breathing: Breathe rhythmically and avoid bracing the upper body during sustained work.
indoor_cycling.tempo: Choose a cadence and resistance that stay smooth without bouncing in the saddle.
indoor_cycling.safety: Secure feet and all adjustment levers. Stop if knee, hip, or back discomfort develops.

rowing_ergometer.title: Rowing Ergometer
rowing_ergometer.setup: Secure the feet, sit tall, and begin at the catch with shins near vertical and arms long.
rowing_ergometer.movement: Drive legs first, swing the torso slightly, then pull to the lower ribs. Return arms, torso, then knees.
rowing_ergometer.breathing: Exhale through the drive and inhale during the controlled recovery.
rowing_ergometer.tempo: Make the recovery slower than the drive and keep stroke timing consistent.
rowing_ergometer.safety: Do not round the lower back or yank early with the arms. Keep the chain level and controlled.

stair_climber.title: Stair Climber
stair_climber.setup: Step on while the machine is stopped, select a low speed, and use rails only for balance.
stair_climber.movement: Place the whole foot on each step, stay tall, and climb with steady alternating steps.
stair_climber.breathing: Use even rhythmic breathing and lower the speed before form or breathing deteriorates.
stair_climber.tempo: Maintain a deliberate pace without riding the steps downward.
stair_climber.safety: Do not support body weight on the rails or skip steps at speed. Slow the machine before exiting.
